headline: Tech giants' political spending raises questions about AI regulation influence
body: Nvidia, Apple, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and Meta collectively donated $92M to Trump's inaugural event, marking significant political engagement from AI-leading companies. This coordinated spending occurs as healthcare AI faces increasing regulatory scrutiny around safety, bias, and clinical deployment. The donations signal these vendors' interest in shaping AI policy at the federal level, which directly impacts how healthcare organizations can implement and govern AI tools in clinical workflows and EHR systems. Healthcare IT leaders should monitor how this political engagement translates into regulatory frameworks that will govern AI adoption in hospitals and health systems over the next administration.
